integrity: The infinite family formula is proved symbolically. Exhaustive computation for orders up to 16 vertices is only a consistency check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for equal-clique barbells with order parameter at least three; unequal clique sizes and longer connecting paths are not treated.
The 2019 restrained-domination-polynomial paper was available only at abstract level in the lawful access path used, leaving a residual literature risk.
An indirect 1997 precursor to restrained domination was identified only with issue-level dating; the first_public_date records the earliest exact day-level public source date verified here.
title: Restrained-domination polynomial of barbell graphs
